description: This PHP source file defines the 'Workbook' class within the 'PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\' namespace, responsible for generating and writing Excel XLS workbook files in BIFF8 format. It includes methods for constructing the workbook, managing styles, fonts, colors, shared strings, and worksheet data, and assembling the binary BIFF data streams for saving as an XLS file.

classes.name: Workbook
classes.description: Represents an Excel BIFF8 XLS workbook generator, responsible for assembling binary streams, managing styles, fonts, colors, shared strings, worksheets, and writing the complete BIFF data for saving as an XLS file.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Workbook object with the provided Spreadsheet, prepares internal data stores, registers worksheet names, tab colors, and sets up default color palette.

methods.name: addXfWriter
methods.description: Creates and adds a new XF (cell format) record based on a Style object, assigns font, color, and number format indices, and stores it for later writing.

methods.name: addFont
methods.description: Adds a Font object to the internal collection and assigns it a unique index, reusing existing font if already added.

methods.name: addColor
methods.description: Adds a custom RGB color to the palette and returns its index, reusing existing colors when possible.

methods.name: setPaletteXl97
methods.description: Initializes the palette with the default Excel 97+ color set.

methods.name: writeWorkbook
methods.description: Assembles and writes the entire workbook, including global settings, worksheet data, styles, and external references, returning the complete BIFF binary stream.

methods.name: calcSheetOffsets
methods.description: Calculates the offsets of each worksheet within the workbook binary stream for proper referencing.

methods.name: writeAllFonts
methods.description: Writes all stored font records into the BIFF stream.

methods.name: writeAllNumberFormats
methods.description: Writes custom number formats (formats other than built-in ones) into the BIFF stream.

methods.name: writeAllXfs
methods.description: Writes all XF records (cell formats).

methods.name: writeAllStyles
methods.description: Writes style records, currently only a default style.

methods.name: parseDefinedNameValue
methods.description: Parses the value of a DefinedName object, updating cell references to be BIFF-compatible.

methods.name: writeAllDefinedNamesBiff8
methods.description: Writes all defined name records (like print titles and print areas) into BIFF8, including formulas.

methods.name: writeDefinedNameBiff8
methods.description: Constructs a BIFF8 DefinedName record with binary formula data.

methods.name: writeShortNameBiff8
methods.description: Constructs a BIFF8 short name record for defined names with range boundaries.

methods.name: writeCodepage
methods.description: Writes the codepage record indicating text encoding.

methods.name: writeWindow1
methods.description: Writes the WINDOW1 record for window position and options.

methods.name: writeBoundSheet
methods.description: Writes a BOUNDSHEET record for each worksheet, including position, visibility, and name.

methods.name: writeSupbookInternal
methods.description: Writes an internal SUPBOOK record for external workbook references.

methods.name: writeExternalsheetBiff8
methods.description: Writes external sheet references used in formulas (XREF).

methods.name: writeStyle
methods.description: Writes a default STYLE record.

methods.name: writeNumberFormat
methods.description: Writes a custom number format to BIFF.

methods.name: writeDateMode
methods.description: Writes the date mode (1904 or 1900) record.

methods.name: writeCountry
methods.description: Writes the COUNTRY record for locale information.

methods.name: writeRecalcId
methods.description: Writes the RECALCID record for recalculation control.

methods.name: writePalette
methods.description: Writes the custom color palette record.

methods.name: writeSharedStringsTable
methods.description: Writes the SST (Shared String Table) including handling of continue blocks and string encoding.

methods.name: writeMsoDrawingGroup
methods.description: Writes the MSODRAWINGGROUP record if needed (drawing objects).

methods.name: getEscher
methods.description: Returns the Escher object for drawings.

methods.name: setEscher
methods.description: Sets the Escher object for drawing groups.
